findings.evidence: The Statement omits Countable Choice, while Given assumes it and step 3.1 invokes F7 when selecting smooth approximants. The cited Sobolev and closure definitions also assume Countable Choice. State and declare that assumption, or supply a choice-free proof with compatible interfaces. The assigned consumer already assumes full AC, so its p=2 application remains covered.

F6 calls the Sobolev norm a sum of component Lp norms, but its cited definition gives the p-root of the sum of pth powers. F7 labels def-axiom-of-choice as Countable Choice, although it defines full AC. Correct F6 to the actual norm convention and cite and declare def-countable-choice in F7. These wording defects do not disprove the checked p=2 estimate.
